_figma_help: One design_system file per project. design_files is a list of {name, url, file_key, role: screens|source, content: frames|screenshots|mixed, library_updates_accepted: true|false}. file_key is the part of the URL after /design/ or /file/. layout: separate (default) | single-file (Scenario C, DS inside the Design file, Intake section 7g: design_system and design_files[0] share one file_key, ds_pages lists the DS page names, library_updates_accepted is null and publish is replaced by history versions).
_mobile_help: Mobile projects only (intake 1.3-1.5). mobile_setup: native | cross-platform | mobile-adaptive. Both + native: this folder is one platform (iOS or Android); sibling_project is the other platform folder (e.g. My Projects/<Project>_Android/); its Design files are linked only to this folder's DS. brand_foundation (optional, native only): {name, url, file_key} of '<Project> Brand Foundation' (Primitives only), copied into this DS as local Primitives, never enabled as a library.
_storybook_help: storybook_plan: yes | later | no (intake 0.7). storybook_ask_at when later: components-approved | screens-approved | next-session. Register Design files with: python tools/project_status.py "<folder>" --add-design-file <url> --name "<name>".
_code_help: Scenario D (Code to Design, Intake section 6) only. code_to_design: existing-ds | new-ds. source_code: {repo, branch, path, preview_url}. existing-ds: figma.design_system.shared is true and editable_pages lists the only DS pages that may be written; design_files may hold a role: reference entry (read only).
